# Slot 88 Mainline Entry (called from oe_mainline_lock.txt ONLY when oe_bal_rule_is_on = yes & Jan).
oe_bal_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			oe_bal_rule_is_on = yes
			current_month = 1
			NOT = { global_var:oe_bal_ran_y ?= current_year }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_bal_ran_y value = current_year }
		oe_bal_emit_snapshot = yes
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dev Panel Page 82 Helpers (Slot 88 Observer Telemetry — STRICT CMDLOG=0!)
# ==============================================================================

# Dev Page 82: Force-enable Observer Telemetry override (global_var:oe_bal_rule_override = 1).
oe_bal_dev_set_mode_on = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_bal_rule_override value = 1 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bal.90
}

# Dev Page 82: Force-disable Observer Telemetry override (global_var:oe_bal_rule_override = 2).
oe_bal_dev_set_mode_off = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_bal_rule_override value = 2 }
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bal.90
}

# Dev Page 82: Fire one immediate full 29-power snapshot via HIDDEN event oe_bal.99 (CMDLOG=0!).
oe_bal_dev_fire_snap = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_bal_force_full_29 value = 1 }
	trigger_event_silently = oe_bal.99
}

# Dev Page 82: Open Slot 88 Read-Only Telemetry Audit Console (oe_bal.90).
oe_bal_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bal.90
}

# Read-only v11.0 cross-worker variable contract schema (never executed at runtime).
oe_bal_v110_contract_schema = {
	if = {
		limit = { always = no }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_heg2_tension value = 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_on value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_ended value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_end_outcome value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_end_bloc value = 1 }
	}
}
